name: labs/festo-se__festo-dev-fluid-control
title: Festo pressure-over-liquid instrument (FluidControlSession)
intro: Festo pressure-over-liquid instrument (FluidControlSession), adapted from festo-se/festo-dev-fluid-control. It reads `channels`, `liquid_classes` and `fluid_status`; sets `pressure`; runs `aspirate`, `dispense`, `mix` and `deactivate`. `aspirate`: aspirate a volume on one valve channel with a configured liquid class. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
